reapack.name: ReaFlip.jsfx
reapack.desc: ReaFlip: sample-chopping instrument with 16 cue pads

version.author: Christian Frei
version.changelog: Play removed: the Play button and the SLAB's PLAY button no longer start or stop the sample. It plays only during a lazy chop pass. Saved projects and learned maps keep working.

version.author: Christian Frei
version.changelog: Play auditions the sample from its beginning; a second press pauses and leaves the playhead there. Play is lit only while it plays. The dial press no longer plays. Optional LCARS look per instance. The load action selects, arms and scrolls to the ReaFlip track.

version.author: Christian Frei
version.changelog: MIDI controller list: the AlphaTheta SLAB preset is the default, so the SLAB works without Learn. Also Pads only and Learned. Learn moved next to the list.
